scoring_justification: Predicted moduli are deterministic from the provided formula and parameters. The checker recomputes the expected values for each Vf and verifies the agent's output within a small floating-point tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected indentation moduli from the scaling law
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Computed directly from Eq.(1) with the parameters stated in the instruction (E1%=4 MPa, Gamma values 78.0, 18.5, 10.3 nm, Gamma_min=5 nm). These numbers correspond to the model predictions in Table S1 of the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct evaluation of the algebraic expression with the above constants.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are exact outputs of the formula which the agent is instructed to implement; no external data or fabricated labels are used.

outputs.description: Predicted indentation modulus for CNT volume fractions 1%, 10%, 20% from the scaling model.

output_contract.notes: The model parameters (inter-CNT spacing values and baseline modulus at Vf=1%) are provided in the instruction. The agent must use the scaling law with a minimum inter-CNT spacing of 5 nm to compute the predicted indentation modulus.
